question: National Family Benefit Scheme was started in August ______ by Government of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1995.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS) is a social assistance scheme launched by the Government of India in 1995. **
 
• The scheme provides f**inancial assistance to below-poverty-line (BPL) families on the death of their primary breadwinner.**
 
• The assistance amount is** Rs. 20,000 **and is given to the eligible family member within 45 days of the death of the breadwinner.
 
• The scheme is implemented by the** Ministry of Rural Development and is available in all states and union territories of India.**
